notes: BUB1B NM_001211.6 compound heterozygote. c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter (TTA>TGA, UGA, NMD-competent, >50nt from last exon junction) with c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys (pseudokinase domain). Mosaic variegated aneuploidy type 1. Recovered by a 12-gene panel built live from Ensembl. Phase inferred from phenotype, not observed: no parental samples and the variants are 10911 bp apart, beyond 2x149bp read span. Splicing excluded for N1002K by AlphaGenome (p~0.95 against 22 local controls) and SpliceAI (0.02 vs 0.2 threshold, in a run where a control scored 1.00). AVI attribution for N1002K is 63% AlphaMissense, 2.8% across all nine regulatory tracks. Absence of consanguinity (longest autosomal ROH <2.6Mb) independently supports two alleles from two parents.

LZTR1 p.Tyr748Ter, monoallelic inactivating (TAC>TAG: both a stop codon and an AG splice acceptor consensus, which is why SpliceAI returns DS_AG 0.92 here). Schwannomatosis-type allele. No germline second hit anywhere in the locus or surrounding 1 Mb. Candidate contributor to the malignant soft tissue tumour under two-hit logic only if a somatic second hit exists; a genome-wide subclonal LOH scan of blood was negative with a floor of 12-15% tumour fraction, which is far above the ctDNA fraction expected for a localized paediatric sarcoma, so this is untestable from blood rather than excluded.

SLC34A1 rs148976897 c.398C>T p.Ala133Val, heterozygous, ClinVar conflicting (likely benign / likely pathogenic / VUS), gnomAD max 0.0101. Reported as a closed negative rather than a candidate: the locus was swept for a second allele in both coding and non-coding space, no second damaging allele exists, no phase tag exists anywhere in the gene, and an AlphaGenome saturation scan of all 94839 possible SNVs placed the only rare upstream allele at the 67th percentile. Nephrocalcinosis is better explained by prematurity and neonatal diuretic exposure.
